entries.053c14342d5aba3f: The company manufactures and sells chemical protective clothing using DuPont™ Tyvek® software and Tychem®, its original protective clothing, and other protective clothing made of nonwoven material. It proposes protective clothing and safety equipment suited to each application, such as infection control, radioactive dust countermeasures, chemical substance countermeasures, cleanroom work and arc flash countermeasures, and also provides donning and doffing training for end users. Revenue for each product alone is not disclosed.

entries.2cb334a0f518d7ae: It sets out 'Protecting people and the environment with safety and protection systems' as its social mission, and under its medium-term management plan 'Next Stage Implementation Plan 2026', covering May 2026 to April 2029, its management policies are: strengthening the 'Protecting people and the environment' business (developing the Healthcare Products Business, the new protective clothing field and the safety and environmental equipment field); enhancing the AZEARTH brand and improving customer problem-solving capability through DX; and building an attractive corporate group that is chosen by stakeholders. It identifies responding to 3 key themes as important: harmful chemical substances, infectious diseases and work environment risks.

entries.a64ed2c3570434c4: The company has manufactured and sold chemical protective suits since 1975 and has accumulated expertise in protective clothing over more than 40 years. Its distinguishing feature is that employees with specialized knowledge check the working environment before proposing suitable protective clothing and safety protective equipment, and provide donning and doffing training for end users at the time of delivery. At its own plant in Daisen, Akita Prefecture, it sews protective clothing and produces non-woven masks, giving it manufacturing functions as well.
entries.a9995ea56c4cdfae: A reportable segment of the company’s group that manufactures and sells medical products such as nonwoven masks and medical gowns. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended April 2026 was ¥388 million. Nonwoven masks are manufactured at the company’s own factory, AZEARTH Design Center Akita, and the company’s own-brand masks are sold mainly to companies that use masks for work purposes. Contract-manufactured masks are sold to distributors through the equity-method affiliate Medicare Japan Co., Ltd.

entries.d70a37b043a69c78: Regulations on occupational safety and health are being tightened, including strengthened autonomous management of chemical substances and mandatory heatstroke countermeasures in the workplace, and meeting demand for personal protective equipment is a business opportunity. On the other hand, uncertainty in the overseas economy and rising energy costs from higher crude oil prices are cited as downside risks to business activities.
entries.d8a10cb82928db3c: In the fiscal year ended April 2026, demand rose in the core Protective Clothing and Environmental Equipment Business for cleanroom applications and harmful chemical substance countermeasures, and sales to general consumers at drugstores and other outlets grew in the Healthcare Products Business, so revenue turned to an increase after several consecutive periods of decline. On the other hand, although contracts in the new protective clothing field and the safety and environmental equipment field have been progressing, they fell short of the initial plan, and they are positioned as fields to be developed under the new medium-term management plan.
